outline: To teach students the concepts and skills of vibration and noise control. Topics include Mechanical vibration, Vibration transmission, Vibration measurement, The use of vibration isolators and absorbers, Fundamentals of acoustics, Noise control engineering, Instrumentation.
schedule:
1~3  vibration theory
4~5  acoustics
6    adaptive filter
7~8  ANC broadband feedfoward control
9   MidTerm Exam
10~12  ANC narrowband feedfoward control
13~14  ANC feedback control
15~16  online secondary path modeling
17    demos of vibration and noise control experiments
18  Final Exam
assessment:
1 Home Works 作業 20 %
2 Tests 考試 70 %
3  Attendance 出缺席及上課表現 10 %
materials:
